conservative.requirements: Intelligence 4+, an ally within close range is assembling a dice pool for a Social action check. Effect: You cite an appropriate scrap of folk wisdom pertaining to the current situation.

reckless.requirements: Intelligence 4+, an ally within close range is assembling a dice pool for a Social action check. Effect: You cite an appropriate scrap of folk wisdom pertaining to the current situation. When an ally within close range is assembling a dice pool for a Social action, you may add 4 recharge tokens to this card to add {Dc} to the dice pool. Special: If you have Folklore trained, add an additional {De} to the dice pool.
